fieldValues.title: Revisit
fieldValues.article_text: A condition tied to the why, not only a date: a sign it isn't working, and a sign it has done its job. Checked by: mechanical for presence; judgement for whether it can be observed.
fieldValues.rationale: From the owner's meeting review and the muDemocracy guide. clerk#270 tests these conditions once they exist; the ask format has no field for them yet.
